---
title: agileflow.lock
description: "The exact versions and hashes that agileflow sync reproduces."
---

`agileflow.lock` records resolution. It is generated; do not edit it. Commit it next to `agileflow.yaml`.

```yaml
# Generated by AgileFlow. Do not edit by hand.
# Records the exact skill versions `agileflow sync` reproduces.
version: 1
resolved:
  diagnosing-bugs:
    source: "@agileflow/diagnosing-bugs"
    version: 1.0.1
    integrity: sha256-NPXz0qG+8Yj+Krt+03iGVnA2Q7FluotOZC/clkAKrGU=
    path: .agents/skills/diagnosing-bugs
    renderedHash: sha256-JUNeswhnIqtLFD20KesSozHF9cHeCN6NjK+EWQ8k2RQ=
    activation: auto
    ownership: managed
  filing-pr:
    source: .agents/skills/filing-pr
    version: local
    path: .agents/skills/filing-pr
    activation: auto
    ownership: local
```

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `source` | Same as in `agileflow.yaml`. |
| `version` | Exact version: semver for registry skills, the package version or `0.0.0-git.<sha>` for git, the package version or `local` for paths. |
| `resolved` | The exact git commit, for git sources. `sync` checks out this commit. Must be a full commit id. |
| `ref` | Git sources: the branch, tag, or commit from `agileflow.yaml` that `resolved` came from. A different `ref:` in `agileflow.yaml` makes `sync` ask for `update`. |
| `integrity` | Hash of the **source** package as published (every file's path, executable bit, and content). Checked before installing. Absent for locally owned skills. |
| `path` | Install location relative to the project (or home for personal skills). |
| `renderedHash` | Hash of the **rendered** skill directory exactly as AgileFlow installed it: the source plus render inputs (managed notice, question preference overlay, activation metadata). A different current hash means you modified the skill. The hash ignores line endings and executable bits, so a Windows or `core.autocrlf` checkout of an unchanged skill is still clean; files AgileFlow cannot track (symlinks, a nested `.git`, `node_modules`, empty directories) make the skill count as modified. The same `integrity` with a new `renderedHash` means only the render inputs changed, and `sync` re-renders clean skills. See [Question preferences](/concepts/question-preferences). |
| `activation` | Activation used when installing (default `auto`). |
| `ownership` | `managed` (AgileFlow owns the content) or `local` (you own it: forks and registered local skills). |
| `enabled` | `false` when the skill is disabled; omitted otherwise. |

Keys are written in a stable order and skills are sorted by id, so lockfile diffs stay readable. The personal lockfile, `~/.config/agileflow/agileflow.lock`, has the same format.

Ownership comes only from this file. AgileFlow never decides it owns a skill from its name.

The CLI version and skill versions are independent: a newer CLI does not change your locked skills, and skill updates do not need a new CLI.

## Compatibility across AgileFlow versions

A lockfile written by a newer AgileFlow can carry fields an older one does not know; they are kept when the older CLI rewrites the file. A lockfile with a newer format `version` stops every command with a message to upgrade the CLI. To make a whole team use a compatible CLI, set `agileflow: ">=5.1.0"` in `agileflow.yaml`.
